steps.code:
# Fetch content for all habit notes and extract data
import re

habit_data = []
for note in habit_notes:
    note_detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=simple_note_login['access_token'], note_id=note['note_id'])
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    date_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note_detail['title'])
    if not date_match:
        continue
    date_str = date_match.group(1)
    # Parse content lines
    habits = {}
    for line in note_detail['content'].splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            key, value = line.split(':', 1)
            key = key.strip()
            value = value.strip().lower()
            if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                habits[key] = value
    habit_data.append({'date': date_str, **habits})

# Sort by date ascending
habit_data.sort(key=lambda x: x['date'])

# Print first few to verify
print(habit_data[:2])
